description: This file defines the SupportsDeleteV2 interface, a mix-in for supporting delete operations in data source tables within Apache Spark's SQL connector framework. It includes methods for checking delete feasibility and performing delete operations based on filter predicates.

classes.name: SupportsDeleteV2
classes.description: An interface providing support for delete operations on data source tables, including methods to check delete capability and execute delete based on predicates.

methods.name: canDeleteWhere
methods.description: Checks if delete operation is feasible for given filter predicates; defaults to true.

methods.name: deleteWhere
methods.description: Performs delete operation on data source table for rows matching the provided predicates.

methods.name: truncateTable
methods.description: Default method that deletes all rows by using an AlwaysTrue predicate if delete is supported.
